category_title: Improving ELL student motivated by practical and interest-based literacy
scenario_title: Managing large homework loads in Physical Science
minimal_context: The student is reviewing daily packets for his Physical Science class to complete outside of the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at your Physical Science assignments. You have these daily packets to complete outside of the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Well, I’m not the best, but I’m not bad so I would put myself in the middle. I don’t do bad but not great.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, let's just start working on the first packet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am receptive to putting forth the effort required, even if it challenges me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep going, you still have a lot of work from these packets to finish outside of the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Expresses frustration) I get frustrated with teachers who assign a lot of work outside of the classroom. I often fail the classes in which too much work is assigned.
